observation: The ring is the only silhouette cue in the set and it reads clearly: a flat annulus leaning at the planet's obliquity, its low side carried down to the disc by the support web, which is the documented 47-degree fill rather than a defect. The ring's outer rim stays inside the Ø34.00 disc in top view. Globe, collar and flat bed face as elsewhere; one solid, nothing floating and nothing overhanging the bed face.
